entries.0c122b9db73f6ae5: It mainly handles transport of international ocean freight and provides incidental services such as export and import customs clearance, cargo storage and packing, preparation of shipping documents, and arrangement of marine cargo insurance, as well as 3PL services that take on logistics work that shippers used to carry out themselves, such as procurement, storage, inventory, sorting, distribution and delivery. It also adds additional services, including the Cargo Information Service, which provides information on shipments and arrivals via its website.

entries.4ff4df63143771ed: Operating costs for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥48,107 million, up 5.6% year on year; operating profit was ¥4,196 million, up 3.0%; ordinary profit was ¥4,680 million, up 3.3%; and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥3,175 million, up 4.2%. Although the gross profit margin fell 0.5 percentage points from the previous year, the company says it pursued price pass-through by negotiating price revisions for ocean freight rates and domestic land transport costs with some customers, and that this showed improvement from the sharp decline seen from the summer of the previous year. Selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥6,095 million, up 1.2% year on year.

entries.58d0fb1ae92bcaca: The company and its 6 consolidated subsidiaries (Nisshin Unyu Co., Ltd. in Japan, two companies in China, and one each in Taiwan, Vietnam and Myanmar) and 6 affiliates (of which 5 are equity-method affiliates) make up the group. It is a freight forwarder (freight forwarding business operator) that does not have its own means of transport and uses the services of actual carriers such as shipping companies according to customer demand. Among these, it corresponds to an NVOCC handling international ocean freight, and the annual securities report states that, as an independent company not belonging to any particular trading house or manufacturer group, it has built a network of offices with an emphasis on China.

entries.915be63f7d3c60c3: This is the reportable segment handled by the local subsidiaries in China. The consolidated subsidiaries in China are 2 companies, Shanghai Aitoku International Logistics Co., Ltd. and Nisshin International Logistics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.; the company has entrusted to Shanghai Aitoku International Logistics Co., Ltd. the cargo transportation business in China. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥7,005 million (up 2.0% year on year), and segment profit was ¥661 million (down 2.6% year on year). The securities report states that by stably handling cargo bound for Japan, it was able to secure transportation-related revenue within China. Segment profit was affected by the gross profit margin falling below the previous year, although profit improvement progressed. The group's cargo handled is mostly sea freight between Japan and China, and as of February 28, 2026, it had bases in China in Shanghai, Dalian, Tianjin, Qingdao, Suzhou, Ningbo, Xiamen, Shenzhen and others.
entries.979c57895d47b1fc: A reportable segment based in Japan, and the one with the larger operating revenue from external customers of the 2 reportable segments. It is handled by the Company and its domestic consolidated subsidiary Nisshin Unyu Co., Ltd., to which import and export customs clearance operations and warehouse work in Japan are outsourced. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue was ¥49,731 million (up 5.5% year on year) and segment profit was ¥3,359 million (up 5.5%). The securities report states that operating revenue increased because the year began with freight rates at a high level due to the rise in ocean freight rates from around summer of the previous fiscal year, and because the number of customs clearance orders increased to 152,656 (up 9.6% year on year) and the number of containers handled in ocean freight transport increased to 256,851 TEU in total for exports and imports (up 3.2%). Segment profit increased due to improved gross profit from price pass-through and restrained selling, general and administrative expenses.
entries.a108e12256ceb657: This segment consists of local subsidiaries in Taiwan, Vietnam and Myanmar, which the securities report describes as 'business segments not included in reportable segments'. Taiwan Aitoku International Logistics Co., Ltd., AIT VIETNAM CO.,LTD., and NISSHIN (MYANMAR) CO., LTD. are responsible for this. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,663 million (up 2.4% year on year), and segment profit was ¥175 million (down 16.0% year on year). The securities report states that operating revenue increased because the Myanmar subsidiary secured stable transportation-related revenue, and the Taiwan subsidiary's handling of imported cargo from Japan declined but orders for triangular transport remained firm. Segment profit declined mainly because of expenses rising in connection with the business activities of the Myanmar subsidiary.
